verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs state that after initialization both Client and Server SDKs evaluate gates and experiments without a network request, typically in under 1ms. Environment-specific SDK keys determine which rule sets the SDK downloads, and Statsig handles caching. Missing for 10: an explicit microsecond-level latency figure (docs only say under 1ms), documentation of how the server-side cached ruleset is refreshed or synced in the background, and independent hands-on corroboration of local-evaluation performance.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, my server SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset — microsecond decisions with no network call per flag check
